title: Minimax Rates for Causal Survival Net Benefit with Selected Samples and Audits
banked_reason: Delivered tier incremental < floor field; not salvageable within scope. Independent terminal-validity audit confirms mathematical pass and rubric-only editorial defects.
gap_reasons: Delivered tier incremental < floor field; not salvageable within scope.

The certificate is roughly 3×10^19 at alpha=1, making the displayed interval equal to the entire parameter range at realistic sample sizes, and neither a practical interval demonstration nor a completed application is delivered.

The closing limitation sections contradict the supplied proofs by describing the certificate, coefficient bounds, and critical modulus as unproved; these are stale status claims rather than missing mathematical steps.
proof_attempt_summary: Discovery supplied matched global absolute-risk and honest connected-interval rates for the complete selected-survival-plus-audit experiment, including the critical logarithm and unconditional arm-count certificate; all nine proof-adjudication items were accepted. The math reviewer passed, but the cold referee graded the narrow known-mechanism one-cell benchmark incremental below the field floor, with no bounded same-scope tier repair. Formalization was not started: no Lean module or kernel-checked theorem was produced; practical interval constants, local-null and unknown-mechanism inference, and full-text priority comparisons remain unresolved.
tldr: A fixed selected survival sample and independent source-frame indicators supply different information about the selection normalizer. The proposed benchmark determines minimax absolute risk and uniformly 90 percent honest connected-interval length for independent-pair causal survival net benefit under known beta entry and censoring laws and a public H\"older density class. The candidate orders are \(n^{-1/2}\) for fixed \(\alpha<1\), \((m+n/\log(en))^{-1/2}\) at \(\alpha=1\), and \((m+n^{2(s+1)/(2s+\alpha+1)})^{-1/2}\) for fixed \(\alpha>1\). Boundary extrapolation and a signed-measure pair statistic give the attaining construction to certify. Complete normalized alternatives supply the proposed converse. Auxiliary-count likelihood calibration and regular pairwise causal estimation are established precedents. The contribution is an incremental normalizer benchmark with a causal pairwise application.
gap: Published count calibration and regular survival-comparison inference do not in the inspected texts evaluate this fixed weak-entry source-plus-audit minimax experiment for every \(m\le n\). The critical information inequality and uniformly valid pairwise interval assembly remain unproved.
fill: Matched absolute-risk and honest connected-length orders, an explicit public interval certificate, a legal complete-experiment critical lower alternative, and the necessary and sufficient order-\(n\) audit requirement for root-sample precision.
